name: AgingIO
description: Inspect, import, annotate and export local expression data with explicit biological metadata.

name: AgingPreprocess
description: Prepare model-specific aging inputs without silently changing gene IDs or expression scales.

name: AgingPseudobulk
description: Aggregate raw single-cell counts within donor, sample and cell type; preserve biological replicate identities.

name: RNAAgeCalc
description: Predict human bulk RNA age using official RNAAgeCalc coefficients. Complete signature coverage is required; no imputation or automatic ID mapping. Counts require explicit gene lengths. Does not infer longevity or aging speed.

input_path.description: h5ad or observations-by-genes CSV; first CSV column contains observation IDs.

model_dir.description: Locally deployed, checksum-verified official model bundle directory.

gene_length_key.description: Positive gene lengths in base pairs in h5ad var; required for counts.

tissue.description: Must exactly match the fixed model bundle tissue, e.g. all_tissues.

name: scAgeClock
description: Predict human single-cell transcriptomic age with the published GMA model. Input must exactly match bundle feature ordering and categorical encoding. Runs bounded batches on the requested device.

input_path.description: h5ad or observations-by-genes CSV; first CSV column contains observation IDs.

model_dir.description: Locally deployed, checksum-verified official model bundle directory.

name: SenCID
description: Score human cellular senescence using official SenCID classifiers and published non-denoising preprocessing. DCA denoising is not performed. Reports continuous SID scores separately from predicted ages; no universal binary threshold.

input_path.description: h5ad or observations-by-genes CSV; first CSV column contains observation IDs.

model_dir.description: Locally deployed, checksum-verified official model bundle directory.

name: AgingJointSummary
description: Join model results at an explicit common grain and summarize distinct readouts by donor or donor/cell type; never synthesizes a total aging score.

output_dir.description: Parent directory for a new isolated result directory.

join_keys.description: Explicit keys defining a common grain in every input; each input must be unique on these keys.

name: AgingDifferentialExpression
description: Donor-level PyDESeq2 negative-binomial Wald contrasts on raw bulk or pseudobulk counts. Unpaired analyses require one sample per donor; paired analyses require one sample per donor per condition. Test one cell type at a time. Missing p-values remain missing, not significant.

input_path.description: Observations x genes CSV (first column is observation ID) or h5ad.

compare_groups.description: Reference level first; test level second. Input must contain exactly these groups.

cell_type.description: Optional single cell type to select from pseudobulk metadata before fitting.
